t: The condition that makes the words work
a: لَنْ يُوَافِيَ عَبْدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَقُولُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ. يَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ، إِلاَّ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ النَّارَ
p: Lan yuwāfiya ʿabdun yawma-l-qiyāmati yaqūlu lā ilāha illā-Llāh, yabtaghī bihi wajha-Llāh, illā ḥarrama-Llāhu ʿalayhi-n-nār
m: No servant will arrive on the Day of Resurrection saying there is no god but Allah, seeking the face of Allah by it, without Allah forbidding the Fire to him.
